column2: What the hell is this place?! It's like the whole village is...
one huge cemetery!
And the villagers, too...
For some reason, they're nothing but old men and women...
In this village of $$ケデロン$$...
the bodies of $$兵士達$$ who died in countless wars...
are buried...
All the people in this village...
live under the protection of this enormous cemetery...
Protected by a graveyard?!
I see...
For us black $$羽$$ who believe in the $$アンゲルス教$$, our own remains...
are believed to be sacred vessels needed for us to be reincarnated someday...
Even those in power...
wouldn't start a war around graves they might one day occupy, right...?
So it's a village full of cowards, is it!!
Incidentally, the lives of us black $$羽$$ can broadly be divided into three kinds...
First, there are those who wander the land to hone their skills in pursuit of strength...
They may at times hire themselves out as an army's $$傭兵$$ or a rich man's bodyguard,
but because they seek to live by their own strength, they generally have no fixed home or family.
Next are those who have already gained fame through their strength,
and, once they grow old, establish a home in one particular place...
They raise families, work to preserve their $$種族$$, and use $$奴隷$$s for farming...
or have them conduct trade. Among them, those with particular power...
offer tribute to the $$教皇$$ and $$領主$$s, and are entrusted with running cities and villages...!
My parents fit that pattern...
And the most numerous are those who have already given up seeking strength,
and simply live from day to day in order to survive...
They're the kind of people I hate most in $$この世$$...!
Still, in the real world, the great majority of people are those like them,
and they are the ones who keep it moving...
Those without strength run humble village shops and scrape together a living each day;
when they gather, the result is what we call a town...
They too struggle every day to raise their standard of living, even a little...
Put another way, it is precisely those people at society's bottom who serve as the lubricant that keeps it moving...
After all, human beings are animals with a habit of living in groups...
More importantly, $$ピリポ$$!
Is your family home still quite a ways from here?
It's not very far from here, but...
I'd like to speak first with my younger brother, who lives next door to my family home...
Come to think of it, you too were originally...
one of the black $$羽$$, like us...
